label: [UZ] Know Your Rights
heading: [UZ] Know Your Rights
description: [UZ] Understanding your rights is the first step to protecting yourself and your family.

police.title: [UZ] When Interacting with Police or Immigration Agents
items: [UZ] You do not have to answer questions about your immigration status.
[UZ] You may say: "I want to remain silent."
[UZ] You have the right to refuse a search without a warrant.
[UZ] Ask for a lawyer before signing anything.

ice.title: [UZ] If ICE Comes to Your Home
items: [UZ] Do NOT open the door without a signed warrant.
[UZ] Ask to see it through the window or under the door.
[UZ] You have the right to remain silent.

documents.title: [UZ] Carrying Documents Safely
items: [UZ] Avoid carrying your passport unless advised.
[UZ] Store important documents safely at home.

disclaimer: [UZ] This information is for educational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice. For legal assistance, please contact an immigration attorney or an approved legal service provider.
